summary: Run release-note validation and drafting from the shared, pinned release engine instead of a copy kept in this repository. This public repository reads the private engine with a repository read token.

api.assessment: Changes only how release-note tooling is delivered to CI: impact checks, promotion preflight and release drafting call one versioned engine pinned by commit, with this repository's configuration read as data. Validation rules, drafting rules and published wording are unchanged. Application endpoints, authentication, permissions, processing outputs and storage are unchanged.

rollout: Takes effect for pull requests and promotions once merged into this repository's default branch. Application deployment and package publication rules do not change.
data_effect: None. No job data, processing outputs or published release notes change; existing impact entries remain valid.

developer_notice.reason: Internal release tooling change; no API or application behavior changes.
